Batch crawl stream produces expected Page and Complete events

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"max_concurrent\":2}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        java.util.List<String> urls = java.util.List.of("https://example.com/page1", "https://example.com/page2", "https://example.com/page3");
        var result = Crawlberg.batchCrawlStream(engine, urls);
        System.out.println(result.stream().eventCountMin());
        System.out.println(result.stream().hasPageEvent());
        System.out.println(result.stream().hasCompleteEvent());
    }
}
```
